clock_work: 144 complete ordinary Cargo processes. Per adjacent pair both arms switch the real stub bytes and run ordinary cargo build from ty_wasm, then its first unchanged build. Alternate original→historical and historical→original in 12 independently balanced pair orders per direction. No tracer, wrapper or Cargo JSON in the scored commands. Read ELF, archive and ZIP digests and compile and run the external Rust oracle after both commands in each arm. ty_project runs one unchanged ordinary build per arm in each of another 24 pairs. Verify priming, final JSON rosters and independently retained native counts. No tests run.
gates: Keep every run or preserve the first failure and withhold clocks. Never decode live partial times. Check exact full native product hashes within each arm against fully qualified vectors. Verify ZIP decoded bytes and actual fresh public caller. Compare and publish cross-arm rosters, symbols/outputs and any legitimate divergences in native qualification. Publication of the complete native results and a separate frozen per-arm output binding precede measurement.
native_execution: Require terminal success, both actual edited source directions and every external caller, native ZIP and changed/unchanged process ledger. Independent empty corrected state must return edited bytes. Bind exact per-arm native output vectors and diag/dirty records before clocks. Run unscored preflights in both directions, then reject novel native bytes.
statistical_rule: Four reported endpoints. Per-workflow adjacent paired log ratios and 100000 fixed-seed bootstrap resamples within prespecified direction strata. Two-sided exact permutation over all equally balanced order assignments in each independent stratum. Holm across all four. A win needs corrected p<.05, CI lower bound >1% and at least 16 of 24 pairs faster. Report any significant cost above 1% and both the single edit and edit-plus-first to expose tradeoffs.
